questionText:
The elections of ______ led to the phenomenon of coalition governments in
Indian states.

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Correct answer. Accurately solves the problem for Syllabus Core.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Syllabus Core (Crises of the Constitutional Order):
The February 1967 general elections are described as a 'political earthquake' in Indian politics. While Congress retained a narrow majority at the Centre, it lost power in seven states and was toppled by defections in another. Multi-party coalitions called Samyukta Vidhayak Dal (SVD) formed governments across northern and eastern states, marking the institutional advent of coalition politics in India.

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
For Syllabus Core (Crises of the Constitutional Order):
In 1963, Madras Chief Minister K. Kamaraj proposed that all senior Congress cabinet ministers and Chief Ministers should resign from government office to dedicate their energies full-time to grassroots organizational rejuvenation, making way for younger cadres. Nehru accepted the plan; top leaders including Morarji Desai, Lal Bahadur Shastri, Jagjivan Ram, and S.K. Patil resigned from the Union Cabinet.

Therefore, option (C) is the correct answer.

questionText:
Arrange the events related to the founding of the United Nations (UN) in
chronological order.

 
(A) India has joined the UN
(B) Tehran Conference Declaration of the Three Powers (US, Britain and
Soviet Union)
(C) Signing of the Atlantic Charter by the US President Franklin D.
Roosevelt and British PM Winston S. Churchill.
(D) The UN was founded
 
Choose the correct answer from the options given below:

options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.
Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.
Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.
Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
NCERT Class 12 Contemporary World Politics (Chapter 6: International Organisations, 'Declaration and Evolution of the UN' timeline, p. 83): (C) Signing of the Atlantic Charter by FDR and Churchill took place in August 1941. (B) Declaration of the Three Powers at the Tehran Conference occurred in December 1943. (D) The United Nations was officially founded on 24 October 1945 when the Charter was ratified. (A) India joined the UN as an original founding member on 30 October 1945. Chronological sequence: (C) [1941] -> (B) [1943] -> (D) [24 Oct 1945] -> (A) [30 Oct 1945].
Hence, option (C) is correct.
